title: Save reusable query templates in Google Sheets
body: The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets now lets you save imports as a reusable template that you and your team can run in one step, each with your own Unity Catalog permissions. See [Templates in Google Sheets](/aws/en/integrations/google-sheets/templates) and [Query Databricks data in Google Sheets](/aws/en/integrations/google-sheets/query-data).
